capabilities: Sync Kindle highlights and personal notes into Author-Title Markdown notes with deep links
Match books against a Calibre library and auto-convert non-EPUB formats via ebook-convert
Write annotations back into Calibre's metadata.db
Read EPUBs in an embedded side-by-side pane scrolled to the quoted location
Cache the Kindle annotation database for offline syncs
extras: Desktop-only (isDesktopOnly: true); README warns to close Calibre during sync or conversion because SQLite may lock metadata.db. A standalone Python CLI is retained in the repository for headless automation.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull Kindle highlights into notes or link them to book locations, and Kindle/Calibre workflows need external scripts.

relations.evidence: opens the book directly in a split ePub.js pane scrolled to the exact quote

requires.name: Kindle device or local clippings/annotation files

summary: Desktop plugin that syncs Kindle highlights and notes into Markdown book notes and Calibre, with an embedded side-by-side EPUB reader.
